paragraphs: MILO sells firearms training simulators and range design services to government, military, law enforcement and police agencies worldwide. Agencies worldwide have used MILO since 1994 for first responder and military training. MILO Live designs live shooting ranges for military, law enforcement agencies, firearms professionals and private enthusiasts.

MILO Virtual covers critical incident training, de-escalation, decision support training, tactical judgment training and firearms proficiency training. Systems run from the portable MILO Range M-SATS to the MILO Range Theater and Shoot House, with hundreds of dynamic video training scenarios. Scenarios are shot in high-definition or 4K video and use branching decision trees.

Every simulation solution ships with active shooter scenarios set in schools, houses of worship, retail locations and outdoor events. Optional MILO Course Designer software lets instructors build new interactive video scenarios that apply their own policies and procedures.

quote.text: We don’t just sell equipment; we partner with agencies and their instructors to develop their ideal simulation-based training solution.
